title: Embracing Challenges – Growing Through New Experiences
text: Reflect deeply on your achievements, including the challenges you faced, and link your SMART goal to your future career aspirations.

title: Key Words
bullets: Adaptability – Being able to change when needed
Aspirations – Things you hope for in the future
Growth Mindset – Believing you can improve with practice

title: Understanding Challenges and Growth
bullets: Adaptability allows you to respond effectively to uncertainty or difficulty
Recognising the value in challenges helps develop resilience and insight
Growth mindset focuses on learning from experiences and improving skills

title: Embracing Challenges
sentence: Trying new challenges can build ______ and develop a ______ mindset.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Challenging yourself develops adaptability, resilience, and a growth mindset
Linking experiences to goals helps turn challenges into progress for your future
